chose: OutboundNoAnswer (objective OB2) fires for a caller and host when at least three requests in 30 minutes got no answer (timeout or no_answer) and not one got any answer, from outbound_requests_total. A refusal of any status is an answer and clears it; a caller asking fewer than three times in the window is not judged. It names the worker and the host in says, never a URL. The owner asked for it on 2026-11-21.
options: no answer at all, at least 3 requests in 30 minutes, by caller and host
any non-ok outcome (refusals included) with no ok, by caller and host
the share of no-answers over a threshold
gray: The owner chose to alert on a host gone dark, but nothing fixed the window, the minimum count or whether a refusal counts. A refusal is the worker's to judge (GA2's backoff, a push service's 410), and a minimum of three trades the rarest callers' silence for no page on one stray timeout. The objective is new: no ledger family covers outbound requests yet.
undo: Delete the home-outbound group from home.yml and its tests; or change the matcher to outcome!="ok" to count refusals.
